_doc: Point-in-time retrospective. Every input was public on as_of; see sources. Hindsight lives only in outcome.json.
methodology: house v2 (EPP-distance adjustment), 6-section format; retro method r2: scenario inputs derived from dated facts by frozen rules (retro/README.md); analog semiconductor signals; the listing and short-history bounds rules (AVGO)

pit_profile.why: Avago: 'We are a leading designer, developer and global supplier of a broad range of semiconductor devices with a focus on analog III-V based products and complex digital and mixed signal complementary metal oxide semiconductor based devices', 'We have four reportable segments: wireless communications, enterprise storage, wired infrastructure and industrial & other, which align with our principal target markets', and 'We operate a primarily outsourced manufacturing business model' (its own FY2015 10-K); 'The global semiconductor market is highly competitive', and 'We operate in the highly cyclical semiconductor industry, which is subject to significant downturns': a cyclical and competitive risk, not an obsolescence one

classification.quality_note: Avago: 'We are a leading designer, developer and global supplier of a broad range of semiconductor devices with a focus on analog III-V based products and complex digital and mixed signal complementary metal oxide semiconductor based devices', 'We have four reportable segments: wireless communications, enterprise storage, wired infrastructure and industrial & other, which align with our principal target markets', and 'We operate a primarily outsourced manufacturing business model' (its own FY2015 10-K); 'The global semiconductor market is highly competitive', and 'We operate in the highly cyclical semiconductor industry, which is subject to significant downturns': a cyclical and competitive risk, not an obsolescence one. durable franchise (obsolescence risk 2/5); price fair; Ratio B 0.34x; +150% to EPP floor; model-vs-market gap +0.16; conservative 2yr +106%.

BEAR.desc: EPS -2.7%/yr (worst year FY08-FY15 ex-FY09 ex-FY14, capped at 0%); P/E to its 10th pct

BASE.desc: EPS +112.1%/yr (Q3 FY16 guide YoY + margin + buyback); P/E at its 6.6-yr ex-FY09 ex-FY14 median

BULL.desc: EPS +112.1%/yr (FY08-FY15 ex-FY09 ex-FY14 CAGR, at least BASE); P/E holds its 75th pct

XBULL.desc: EPS +155.0%/yr (best 2-yr run FY08-FY15 ex-FY09 ex-FY14, at least BULL); P/E at its 90th pct

summary: AVGO (retrospective, 2016-06-10) ◉ BUY — Ratio B 0.34x (65.3% downside to Bear $55.81 / +190.7% upside to Bull $467.46) | Adj composite 1.65 vs market 1.49: gap +0.16 [FAIRLY VALUED] | +150% above the EPP floor $64.35 (13x FY16E $4.95) | Conservative 2-yr case: +106.3% total (+53.1%/yr) | At 32.5x FY16E the 15% hurdle price $212.68 sits at or below the BASE case; net revenue +119.4% YoY in Q2 FY16, forward revenues +111.2-119.9% (Q3 FY16 revenue guide (Q2 FY16 release)); no disruption theme has dated evidence.
